Bug_Title: SIO: Unnecessary type check done using instanceof operator (SIO_SUPERFLUOUS_INSTANCEOF)
Bug_Details:
Type check performed using the instanceof operator where it can be statically determined whether the object
is of the type requested.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in line 4, where the instanceof operator is used to check if the object is an instance of String, which can be determined statically.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggered the bug by calling the `showBug()` method, which contained an unnecessary type check using the `instanceof` operator.
